rules.title: Feature-First Organization
rules.check: Organize code by feature/domain, not by technical layer. Each feature is self-contained.
rules.bad_example:
src/
  controllers/
    orderController.ts
    userController.ts
  services/
    orderService.ts
    userService.ts
  repositories/
    orderRepository.ts
    userRepository.ts
rules.good_example:
src/
  features/
    orders/
      order.controller.ts
      order.service.ts
      order.repository.ts
      order.types.ts
      order.schema.ts
    users/
      user.controller.ts
      user.service.ts
rules.rationale: Feature-first keeps related code together and reduces navigation across the codebase.

rules.title: Aliased Imports
rules.check: Use path aliases for imports. No relative path traversals like ../../../.
rules.bad_example:
import { UserService } from '../../../services/user.service';
import { OrderDto } from '../../types/order.types';
rules.rationale: Path aliases are readable, refactor-friendly, and eliminate path confusion.

rules.title: Named Exports Only
rules.check: Use named exports exclusively. Default exports are FORBIDDEN.
rules.rationale: Named exports ensure consistent naming, better tree-shaking, and cleaner refactoring.

rules.title: No Circular Imports
rules.check: The import graph MUST be acyclic. Circular dependencies are FORBIDDEN.
rules.rationale: Circular imports cause runtime issues, initialization problems, and indicate poor design.

rules.title: Layer Boundaries
rules.check: Lower layers MUST NOT import from higher layers. Dependency flows downward only.  **Layer Hierarchy (top to bottom)** 1. Presentation (controllers, routes) 2. Application (use cases, services) 3. Domain (entities, value objects) 4. Infrastructure (database, external APIs)
rules.bad_example:
// domain/order.entity.ts
import { OrderRepository } from '../infrastructure/order.repository'; // Upward violation!
rules.rationale: Strict layering prevents coupling and enables testing/replacement of components.

rules.title: Shared Module Location
rules.check: Shared code MUST live in @/shared or @/core. No direct imports between sibling features.
rules.bad_example:
// features/orders/order.service.ts
import { validateEmail } from '../users/user.utils'; // Cross-feature import!
rules.rationale: Shared modules prevent hidden coupling between features.

rules.title: File Naming Convention
rules.check: Files MUST use kebab-case with purpose suffix: .service.ts, .controller.ts, .types.ts.
rules.good_example:
order.service.ts
order.controller.ts
order.repository.ts
order.types.ts
order.schema.ts
order.test.ts
rules.rationale: Consistent naming enables quick identification of file purpose.

rules.title: Type Naming Convention
rules.check: Types use PascalCase. Interfaces prefix with I only for contracts (not data shapes).
rules.bad_example:
type orderDto = { }; // camelCase
interface IOrderDto { } // I prefix on data shape
type ORDER_STATUS = 'pending'; // SCREAMING_CASE
rules.rationale: Consistent naming improves readability and distinguishes interfaces from types.

rules.title: Variable and Function Naming
rules.check: Variables and functions use camelCase. Constants use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
rules.bad_example:
const MaxRetries = 3; // PascalCase constant
function ProcessOrder() { } // PascalCase function
const ORDER_SERVICE = new OrderService(); // SCREAMING for instance
rules.rationale: Case conventions communicate identifier purpose at a glance.

rules.title: Index Files for Public API
rules.check: Use index.ts only to define public API of a module. No logic in index files.
rules.rationale: Explicit exports define clear module boundaries and prevent internal leakage.

rules.title: File Size Limits
rules.check: Files SHOULD NOT exceed 500 lines. Split large files into focused modules.
rules.rationale: Smaller files are easier to navigate, review, and maintain.

rules.title: Dependency Injection
rules.check: Dependencies MUST be injected via constructor. No direct instantiation of dependencies.
rules.rationale: DI enables testing, loose coupling, and runtime configuration.

rules.title: Configuration Management
rules.check: Configuration MUST be validated at startup and accessed via typed config module.
rules.rationale: Validated configuration fails fast and prevents runtime config errors.

rules.title: No Mutable Global State
rules.check: Mutable global state is FORBIDDEN. Use dependency injection or module-scoped constants.
rules.rationale: Global mutable state causes race conditions, testing difficulties, and hidden coupling.

rules.title: Explicit Boot Order
rules.check: Application initialization MUST have explicit order. No side effects on import.
rules.rationale: Explicit initialization enables testing, error handling, and controlled startup.

rules.title: No default exports
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No default exports

rules.title: No circular imports
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No circular imports

rules.title: No relative path traversals (`../../../`)
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No relative path traversals (`../../../`)

rules.title: No cross-feature direct imports
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No cross-feature direct imports

rules.title: No upward layer violations
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No upward layer violations

rules.title: No mutable global state
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No mutable global state

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No side effects on import

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `export *` re-exports (explicit exports only)
